LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.7: Imitative Speaking

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Imitative Speaking. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how to take care of household items. 1. Why do we need various items in our homes?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify positions of household items in relation to others

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Imitative Speaking helps you communicate well at school and at home.

• Listen with your eyes and ears. Face the speaker and wait for your turn.

• When you speak, use a clear voice and polite words.

• Practise short dialogues with a partner using Kenyan school situations.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short instruction, then repeat it to a friend in your own words.

Example 3: Role-play buying an item at the market using polite requests: “Please…”, “Thank you.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Practise a 30-second greeting dialogue with a partner.
2. Listen to three instructions and carry them out in order.
3. Tell a short news item from your day using complete sentences.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Teach a younger learner one polite greeting from this lesson.
2. Write five sentences you can say when welcoming a visitor at school.
3. Ask a parent to give you three oral instructions; write them down after listening.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Work collaboratively to discuss the uses of the various household items in homes,
2. Locate positions of household items in relation to other items using prepositions (in, on, at, under, above)
3. Listen to an audio recording and articulate target words correctly in pairs,
4. Discuss how to take care of household items. 1. Why do we need various items in our homes? 2. How can we tell the position of an item in the house? 6
5. Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to an audio recording and articulating target words correctly.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to take care of household items. 1. Why do we need various items in our homes?
2. How can we tell the position of an item in the house?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Good listeners look, wait, and respond.
2. Clear speech helps others understand you.
3. Polite language shows respect.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
